section_summary.extract_value: This section describes the Body Appreciation Scale (BAS), a 13-item instrument used to measure body appreciation with a 5-point Likert scale. The text notes that the BAS has demonstrated unidimensional structure, good test-retest reliability, and construct validity in previous research with Western women. The present study used the BAS and reported a Cronbach's alpha of .89, indicating good internal consistency.
